name: Jermaine Cobbins
strengths: Cobbins uses 6-0 length to stay stacked on the perimeter and disrupt releases at the line.
Cobbins shows patience in man coverage — does not bite early on stems.
Cobbins closes to the football and contests catches without panicking.
weaknesses: Cobbins (6-0 / 175) still needs functional strength to finish vs physical SEC receivers at the catch point.
comparison: Cobbins comps to Patrick Surtain II — 6-0 long-armed press corner who stacks receivers and stays patient in phase.
projection: Cobbins projects as a Year 2–3 SEC starter at CB (special teams / nickel Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC press corner — the length CB who stacks and stays patient in phase.
schemeFit: Cobbins fits press/man + pattern-match CB who wins with length and patience on the boundary.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-04 from On3 profile Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Jermaine Cobbins is a 4-star CB · listed 6-0 / 175 · Springfield (Springfield, TN) (TN) · open-board Florida target.
angle: Lead with Springfield TN soph Hudl length/press; Tennessee-to-Florida CB chase.
insiderNotes: Cobbins is a 6-0 long-armed press corner who stacks receivers, stays patient through stems, and contests at the catch point. Wins with length, patience, and phase discipline. A boundary CB mold who can grow into every-down snaps once strength catches the frame.
